title: Scenic Santa Monica Electric Mountain Bike Tour (Beginner)
includes: 2025 Specialized Kenevo Expert Electric Mountain Bike and protective pads.
Full Premium mountain bike gear, helmet, and eyewear
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us on this unique electric mountain biking experience that winds through forests of sycamore trees and crosses springtime creeks. Explore the stunning Santa Monica Mountains on premium electric mountain bikes ( Husqvarna, Specialized, Haibike). This trail system features an optional single track, allowing participants to switch between the beginner fire road and the Ridgeline Roller Coaster ride. Both routes run side-by-side so everyone stays together while riders of different levels enjoy their own pace. Riders of all levels welcome—no experience needed. You’ll take in sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean and mountain ranges en route to the Nike Missile Control site, where we’ll stop to explore this Cold War relic. This adventure gives you an authentic taste of local riding on one of Santa Monica’s favorite trails.
